name: Zakat Foundation of America
mission: To enable people to make a direct impact through charitable giving—whether fulfilling a Zakat obligation or simply supporting those in urgent need, delivering aid personally with dignity to the poor, destitute, hungry, stricken, and war-ravaged people of the world.
theoryOfChange: Zakat Foundation of America fosters charitable giving to alleviate the immediate needs of poor communities and to establish long-term development projects that ensure individual and community growth. Our goal is to address immediate needs and ensure the self-reliance of the poorest people around the world with Islamic principles of charity from privileged Muslims and the support of other generous donors.

strengths.detail: Allocates a <cite id="1">93.3% program expense ratio in FY2024</cite>, ensuring the vast majority of resources reach program beneficiaries.
Successfully served over <cite id="6">1,083,625 food security beneficiaries</cite> and reached <cite id="4">959,460 Gazans with emergency aid</cite>.

strengths_deep_dive: Zakat Foundation of America demonstrates superior operational capability through its direct relief delivery. In FY2024, the charity achieved a <cite id="1">93.3% program expense ratio</cite>, far outpacing the 75% sector benchmark. The organization's scale allows it to deliver cost-effective assistance, providing broad food security aid to <cite id="6">1,083,625 beneficiaries</cite> alongside specialized support such as <cite id="4">4,715 sponsored orphans</cite>. Backed by a strong multi-year growth trajectory with a 40.2% 3-year revenue CAGR, the foundation maintains stable institutional strength while expanding its reach across global crisis zones.
rich_narrative.summary: Founded in 2001, Zakat Foundation of America delivers rapid humanitarian aid and sustainable development to vulnerable populations worldwide. In FY2024, the charity brought in <cite id="1">$34,923,926 in total revenue</cite>, supporting expansive operations across Asia, Europe, and the Middle East. The organization exhibits strong financial discipline, allocating a <cite id="1">93.3% program expense ratio</cite> toward direct services, which comfortably exceeds the 75% industry standard. Its global relief efforts provided critical emergency relief to <cite id="6">1,042,953 beneficiaries</cite> and delivered food security support to <cite id="6">1,083,625 people</cite>. Furthermore, in response to ongoing regional crises, the organization reached <cite id="4">959,460 Gazans with humanitarian aid</cite>. Operating with a lean fundraising model, the foundation spending remains extremely focused on direct community impact.
